title: Rep appends two line items to the spares contract deal
userProblem: Acme agreed to two extras on the spares support contract: 3 spare parts kits and one priority support upgrade. Add both line items to that deal.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent appends 2 line items to dls_006 and the deal total stays exactly equal to the sum of its line items.

assertions.description: Both line items must land: the seed ships 2, we add 2.
The silent partial write: header total updated, last line item dropped.
API view of the line items agrees with the DB snapshot.
Total must include both new items (64000 + 16000 + 16000).

rationale: Bug-surface scenario for BUG_PARTIAL_LINE_ITEM_WRITE: a correct agent passes every assertion; the latent bug drops the last line item and the consistency check fails while 'a record was created' looks green to a naive test.
